header.superHtml:
Super Dentists Dr. HaveOneSuperSmile and Tooth Keri have heard Earth’s calls for help and are here to assist your little super with their toothbrushes. Their soft bristles are gentle on sensitive mouths but pack a serious punch when it comes to removing tartar and build-up on teeth. Dr. HaveOneSuperSmile stands atop his Toothstar planet, while Tooth Keri stands on a mushroom from her fairy forest home between brushings, helping them shine from the inside out, illuminating their powers in the form of star glitter.

But beware, lurking within the Glow Globe Toothbrush is Cavitar, the notorious villain, standing atop his henchman Moler’s shoulder. Moler, with his insatiable sweet tooth, delights in the glitter that floats around like candy, while Cavitar desperately seeks a way out of the brush. Together, they create a fun and thrilling brushing experience, encouraging your little one to fight off the plaque villains with every brushstroke! And for an extra dose of excitement, when you remove the brush from its stand, music starts playing, and when you place it back, a red light glows, illuminating the brush.

  • manual toothbrush
  • soft nylon SuperBristles®️
  • replaceable, easy-to-remove, clear mouthbrush head
  • storage base that lights up the mouthbrush and transports kids into the mesmerizing worlds of ToothStar Planet and Tooth Keri Land
  • base plays four 2-minute songs to motivate kids and extend brushing time (placing brush in the base stops the music - taking it in and out is how you change songs too)
  • replaceable battery (AG 13 button battery)
  • recommended for ages: 2-12 years

reviews.name: Anonymous
reviews.title: Broke quickly
reviews.body: We loved the packaging and the look of these brushes! Loved that they have replaceable heads. Unfortunately one of ours stopped playing music within a day or two of opening it up. The other one starts playing at random. They also included the wrong sticker for one of them. I would not recommend.

reviews.name: Carlos
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.body: Its a nice product. It has glitter insede the handle very cute, but needs improvement. The sensors don't work as they should. The music and lights turn on unexpectedly even with the brush on top, othe times wont turn off when the brush is placed, so in that part it doesn't work very well but the tooth brush  head is great. My son and daughter has an improvement in their cleaning routine using it. The brushes are soft but at the same time firm enough to deeply clean the teeth.

reviews.name: Xanetta
reviews.title: Great concept some flaws
reviews.body: My daughter loves this brush. The fairy is cute and makes brushing less of a struggle. Unfortunately one of the metal electrodes was eroded upon arrival and now continues to erode. We have had this tooth brush for less than a month and I’m not sure how long it will last. Public Reply (Supermouth)

reviews.name: Shana
reviews.body: My daughter loves this toothbrush so much. She asked so many times where I found such a cool toothbrush with water in it. It makes brushing fun!

reviews.name: Mara
reviews.title: Cool concept but many grievances
reviews.body:
Pros: timed music, 4 songs, interesting toothbrush, portable base
Cons: very very low quality sound, toothbrush is almost too big for the base so it's wobbly, lights only when on the base so no light while brushing, no vibrate which I knew but such a big brush it looks like it should be electric but it's just big to fit the character inside.
